description: This file defines classes and APIs for monitoring and retrieving status information about Spark jobs and stages within the PySpark framework. It includes data structures for job and stage info, and a StatusTracker class for querying job/stage statuses via a JavaObject interface.

classes.name: SparkJobInfo
classes.description: Data structure exposing information about Spark jobs, including job ID, associated stage IDs, and status.

classes.name: SparkStageInfo
classes.description: Data structure exposing information about Spark stages, including stage ID, attempt ID, name, and task counts.

classes.name: StatusTracker
classes.description: API class providing methods to monitor Spark job and stage progress, retrieve job/stage info, and list active jobs/stages.

methods.name: getJobIdsForGroup
methods.description: Returns list of job IDs for a specified job group or all jobs if None.

methods.name: getActiveStageIds
methods.description: Returns sorted list of active stage IDs.

methods.name: getActiveJobsIds
methods.description: Returns sorted list of active job IDs.

methods.name: getJobInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SparkJobInfo object for a given job ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: getStageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SparkStageInfo object for a given stage ID, or None if not found.
